import numpy as np

def r(x):
    x = float(x)
    # Move x toward higher end of domain [0,1] to approach asymptotic regime where output increases
    return 0.5 * x + 0.5

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # We expect y_new = program(r(x)) > y_orig = program(x), since r(x) > x and induces higher target mean
    return y_new > y_orig
